summary: Iteration 60: Bug fix VERIFIED - PDF generation for VPOS and PG quotes now works correctly. The fix changed 'quote_data.get("quote_type")' to 'data.quote_type' on line 3000 of server.py. All 9 backend tests passed confirming both VPOS and PG PDF generation paths work.

issues: HTML hydration warning: <tr> inside <span> - caused by React dev tools wrapper, non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: Line 3000 in server.py changed from 'quote_data.get("quote_type")' to 'data.quote_type' - the variable 'quote_data' did not exist in that scope

success_rate.frontend: N/A - Backend API tests verified core functionality

seed_data_creation: Created multiple test quotes with PDFs: COT-2026-03-047-TBP through COT-2026-03-056-TBP
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF generation bug has been fixed. VPOS quotes with pdf_data parameter generate PDFs correctly (889KB). PG quotes without pdf_data use the fallback path (line 3017) and also generate PDFs correctly (875KB). The attachments are stored in the 'Cotización' category and can be downloaded via /api/quotes/{id}/attachments/{att_id}/download endpoint.

verified_features.pg_pdf_generation: PASS - PG quotes without pdf_data use fallback path and generate PDF (875KB)
verified_features.attachments_endpoint: PASS - GET /api/quotes/{id}/attachments returns attachment list with PDFs

bug_fix_details.root_cause: The variable 'quote_data' did not exist in the create_quote_with_pdf function scope. The correct variable is 'data' (the QuoteCreateWithPDF parameter).
bug_fix_details.impact: This caused ALL VPOS PDF generation to fail silently (errors were caught but PDF was not created). PG quotes were not affected because they use a different code path (line 3017).

backend_log_evidence: No errors in backend logs during PDF generation
